title: First Terminal Examination 2026
content: First Terminal Examination will start from September 10, 2026. Students should prepare accordingly. Detailed schedule is posted on the notice board.

title: Annual Sports Day 2026
content: Annual Sports Day will be held on September 5, 2026. All students are requested to participate actively in various sports events.

title: School Closed - Eid Holiday
content: School will remain closed from August 25 to September 1, 2026 for Eid ul-Adha holidays. Classes will resume on September 2, 2026.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting
content: Parent-Teacher Meeting is scheduled for September 8, 2026. All guardians are requested to attend and discuss their child's progress.
